description: Family 2 (sensor interpretation) profile inputs from the family 2 calibration table. Calibration split (200 items, generator sensor-gen-1), non-thinking, temperature 0, 1,024-token output cap. Accuracy is answer accuracy as a fraction. The test and held-out splits are not used here.
source: Family 2 calibration table (Qwen3.5 checkpoints, calibration split, non-thinking, temperature 0)
prompt_tokens_basis: Mean of the four level means (415, 780, 1743, 3834) of the character-based estimate of the family 2 prompt length; plus or minus 10 percent; replace by measured counts after a run.

missing.q35-4b-ih-w4a16: No family 2 calibration number exists for the 4B INT4 build. Its family 2 accuracy and output length are unprofiled until the calibration run covers it.
missing.q35-2b-ih-w8a8: Excluded from the admissible set by the accuracy screen.
missing.q35-2b-ih-w4a16: Excluded from the admissible set by the accuracy screen.

p95_output_tokens_note: A null p95 means the p95 output length was not recorded; the loader then uses the mean output length for the p95 latency shift. For the 4B builds more than 5 percent of replies hit the 1,024-token cap (63 and 65 of 200), so the 95th percentile output length is the cap.
